-- Spec for: swap the first and last elements of a list in place.
-- An empty or one-element list is unchanged.

-- Pure reference: the list with its ends swapped.
ends_swapped(xs: List[int]) -> List[int] =
  pre xs.len() >= 0
  ex ends_swapped([1, 2, 3]) == [3, 2, 1]
  ex ends_swapped([7]) == [7]
  ex ends_swapped([]) == []
  var ys = copy xs
  swap_ends(&ys)
  ys

-- Mutates xs in place; the caller passes &x.
swap_ends(var xs: List[int]) =
  pre xs.len() >= 0
  ex swap_ends([1, 2, 3]) == [3, 2, 1]
  let n = xs.len()
  if n >= 2
    let first = xs[0]
    xs[0] = xs[n - 1]
    xs[n - 1] = first

test_swap_ends() =
  var a = [1, 2, 3]
  swap_ends(&a)
  assert a == [3, 2, 1]
  var b = [7]
  swap_ends(&b)
  assert b == [7]
  var c: List[int] = []
  swap_ends(&c)
  assert c == []
